About Luna Moon

Step Aboard a Legend

Step aboard Luna Moon and discover one of the world's most remarkable classic sailing vessels. Originally built in Holland in 1910, Luna Moon is a beautifully restored 132-foot gaff-rigged topsail schooner with a rich maritime history spanning more than a century.

From her early days as an offshore pilot vessel in the English Channel to her service as a Baltic herring vessel and later a celebrated tall ship, Luna Moon has sailed through some of the most fascinating chapters of maritime history.

The Vessel

A Century of Seafaring

Today, Luna Moon offers an unforgettable way to experience the remote beauty of Madagascar and the Indian Ocean. Combining the romance of traditional sailing with modern comforts, she provides guests with a truly unique adventure far removed from conventional tourism.

Lovingly restored using sustainable materials and traditional craftsmanship, Luna Moon reflects a commitment to preserving maritime heritage while embracing responsible travel. Every detail onboard tells a story — from her original fittings and classic rigging to the carefully repurposed materials used throughout her restoration.

Whether exploring Madagascar's secluded islands, pristine beaches, vibrant marine life or untouched coastal communities, guests aboard Luna Moon enjoy a rare opportunity to slow down, reconnect with nature and experience the ocean as sailors have for generations.
